author: nickyeow

english.text: No sooner had Tom turned on the TV than the fuse blew.

jyutping: aa3 Tom jat1 hoi1 din6 si6 zau6 tiu3 zo2 fuse。
text: 阿 Tom 一開電視就跳咗 fuse。

author: nickyeow

english.text: What does SFX stand for?

jyutping: SFX ze1 hai6 me1 aa3？
text: SFX 啫係咩呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't like him because he loses his temper easily.

jyutping: keoi5 juk1 haa5 zau6 faat3 pei4 hei3，so2 ji5 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 keoi5。
text: 佢郁吓就發脾氣，所以我唔係好鍾意佢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You mustn't eat too much ice cream and spaghetti.

jyutping: nei5 m4 jing1 goi1 sik6 taai3 do1 syut3 gou1 tung4 maai4 ji3 daai6 lei6 fan2。
text: 你唔應該食太多雪糕同埋意大利粉。

author: nickyeow

english.text: He laid down the gun.

jyutping: keoi5 fong3 dai1 zo2 zi1 coeng1。
text: 佢放低咗枝槍。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I'm not talking to you; I'm talking to the monkey.

jyutping: ngo5 m4 hai6 tung4 nei5 gong2 je5，ngo5 hai6 tung4 zek3 maa5 lau1 gong2 je5。
text: 我唔係同你講嘢，我係同隻馬騮講嘢。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Do you know where the police station is?

jyutping: nei5 zi1 m4 zi1 caai1 gun2 hai2 bin1 aa3？
text: 你知唔知差館喺邊呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Wherever she goes, her child follows her.

jyutping: keoi5 zau2 dou3 heoi3 bin1，keoi5 go3 zai2 zau6 gan1 dou3 heoi3 bin1。
text: 佢走到去邊，佢個仔就跟到去邊。

author: nickyeow

english.text: By the way, are you free tonight?

jyutping: waa6 si4 waa6，nei5 gam1 maan1 dak1 m4 dak1 haan4 aa3？
text: 話時話，你今晚得唔得閒呀？

author: nickyeow

english.text: I haven't eaten anything in the past three days.

jyutping: ngo5 saam1 jat6 mou5 sik6 je5 laa3。
text: 我三日冇食嘢喇。

author: fercheung

english.text: His room is always tidy.

jyutping: keoi5 gaan1 fong4 gei2 si4 dou1 hai6 gam3 kei5 lei5。
text: 佢間房幾時都係咁企理。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I had been reading a book when he came in.

jyutping: keoi5 jap6 lei4 go2 zan6 ngo5 tai2 gan2 syu1。
text: 佢入嚟嗰陣我睇緊書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Will you make it in time?

jyutping: nei5 gon2 m4 gon2 dak1 cit3 gaa3？
text: 你趕唔趕得切㗎？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Why is this computer here?

jyutping: dim2 gaai2 nei1 bou6 din6 nou5 wui5 hai2 ni1 dou6 ge2？
text: 點解呢部電腦會喺呢度嘅？

author: nickyeow

english.text: Tom might not want to sing in front of such a large audience.

jyutping: aa3 Tom mei6 bit1 soeng2 hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min2 cin4 coeng3 go1。
text: 阿Tom未必想喺咁多人面前唱歌。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We'd better not get caught.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zeoi3 hou2 m4 hou2 bei2 jan4 faat3 jin6。
text: 我哋最好唔好俾人發現。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The youth of all countries want to talk about their hopes and experiences, but the problem of language remains; the Internet has only solved the problem of distance.

jyutping: so2 jau5 gwok3 gaa1 ge3 hau6 saang1 zai2 dou1 soeng2 taam4 leon6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 lei5 soeng2、keoi5 dei6 ge3 ging1 lik6，daan6 hai6 jyu5 jin4 jing4 jin4 hai6 jat1 go3 man6 tai4；wu6 lyun4 mong5 gaai2 kyut3 zo2 ge3，zi2 bat1 gwo3 hai6 keoi5 lei4 zek1。
text: 所有國家嘅後生仔都想談論佢哋嘅理想、佢哋嘅經歷，但係語言仍然係一個問題；互聯網解決咗嘅，只不過係距離唧。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Layla is worried about you.

jyutping: leoi5 laai1 hou2 daam1 sam1 nei5。
text: 蕾拉好擔心你。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I don't think this is an unreasonable request.

jyutping: ngo5 jau6 m4 gok3 ni1 go3 jiu3 kau4 jau5 gei2 mou4 lei5 wo3。
text: 我又唔覺呢個要求有幾無理喎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I haven't told anybody else.

jyutping: ngo5 zing6 hai6 tung4 zo2 nei5 gong2 zaa3。
text: 我淨係同咗你講咋。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I know all your songs by heart.

jyutping: nei5 go2 di1 go1 ngo5 cyun4 bou6 dou1 sik1 bui3 gaa3。
text: 你嗰啲歌我全部都識背㗎。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I asked him not to bother me.

jyutping: ngo5 giu3 keoi5 m4 hou2 faan4 ngo5。
text: 我叫佢唔好煩我。

author: thesilhouette

english.text: Tom doesn't trust anybody anymore.

jyutping: aa3 tong1 ji4 gaa1 mat1 jan4 dou1 m4 seon3。
text: 阿湯而家乜人都唔信。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is the 1st of June of 2013. I have reached an Intermediate Level in Lojban. I know many words in memory. I can write any prose or poetry that I wish with the help of a handy dictionary for the words that escape me. I know about 90% of the grammar. I guess that I should be satisfied. A nickname that I give Lojban is "zirbau," the Purple Language. Some people still believe in the Orange Dream of some Vling-like Oriental conlang. For me, it is still one foot in reality and one foot in fantasy. Lojban is not just fantasy because it is a realized dream.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2013 nin4 6 jyut6 1 hou6。ngo5 hai2 lok3 gat1 baan1 ji5 ging1 daat6 dou3 zung1 kap1。 ngo5 gei3 jik1 zung1 sik1 hou2 do1 zi6。ngo5 ho2 ji5 hai2 jat1 bun2 fong1 bin6 ge3 zi6 din2 ge3 bong1 zo6 haa6，se2 jam6 ho4 ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 saan2 man4 waak6 ze2 si1 go1，jung6 lai4 wan2 ceot1 ngo5 tou4 bei6 m4 dou2 ge3 zi6。ngo5 sik1 daai6 joek3 90%ge3 man4 faat3。ngo5 gu2 ngo5 jing1 goi1 mun5 ji3。ngo5 bei2 go3 coek3 hou6 Lojban hai6「 zirbau 」，zik1 hai6 zi2 sik1 jyu5 jin4, jau5 di1 jan4 zung6 soeng1 seon3 di1 hou2 ci5 wai4 lam4 gam2 ge3 dung1 fong1 jan4 ge3 caang2 sik1 mung6。deoi3 ngo5 lai4 gong2，keoi5 jing4 jin4 hai6 jin6 sat6 jap6 min6 ge3 jat1 goek3，waan6 soeng2 zung1 ge3 jat1 goek3。Lojban m4 daan1 zi2 hai6 waan6 soeng2，jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai6 jat1 go3 sat6 jin6 ge3 mung6 soeng2。
text: 而家係2013年6月1號。我喺洛吉班已經達到中級。 我記憶中識好多字。我可以喺一本方便嘅字典嘅幫助下，寫任何我想要嘅散文或者詩歌，用嚟搵出我逃避唔到嘅字。我識大約90%嘅文法。我估我應該滿意。我畀個綽號 Lojban 係「 zirbau 」，即係紫色語言, 有啲人仲相信啲好似維林噉嘅東方人嘅橙色夢。對我嚟講，佢仍然係現實入面嘅一腳，幻想中嘅一腳。Lojban 唔單止係幻想，因為佢係一個實現嘅夢想。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It is now the 11th of July of 2014. It is my first time to vicariously travel Greece via Google Maps. It is really more convenient than my physical travel of Greece back in 2002. Recently, also some cities in Peru and Colombia have become open for fascinating virtual excursions on Google Maps. I use my iPad mini's iMaps+ app.

jyutping: ji4 gaa1 hai6 2014 nin4 7 jyut6 11 hou6。ni1 go3 hai6 ngo5 dai6 jat1 ci3 tau3 gwo3 Google dei6 tou4 doi6 lei5 heoi3 hei1 laap6 leoi5 hang4。zan1 hai6 bei2 hei2 ngo5 hai2 2002 nin4 heoi3 hei1 laap6 ge3 sat6 tai2 leoi5 hang4 gang3 gaa1 fong1 bin6。zeoi3 gan6，bei3 lou5 tung4 go1 leon4 bei2 aa3 ge3 jat1 di1 sing4 si5 dou1 hoi1 fong3 zo2，ho2 ji5 hai2 Google dei6 tou4 soeng6 min6 zeon3 hang4 mai4 jan4 ge3 heoi1 ji4 jau4 laam5。ngo5 jung6 gan2 ngo5 bou6 iPad mini ge3 iMaps + jing3 jung6 cing4 sik1。
text: 而家係2014年7月11號。呢個係我第一次透過 Google 地圖代理去希臘旅行。真係比起我喺2002年去希臘嘅實體旅行更加方便。最近，秘魯同哥倫比亞嘅一啲城市都開放咗，可以喺 Google 地圖上面進行迷人嘅虛擬遊覽。我用緊我部 iPad mini 嘅 iMaps + 應用程式。
